To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the correlation among conserved charges, such as baryon number (B), electric charge (Q), and strangeness (S), is studied in the framework of two flavor Polyakov loop-extended Nambu–Jona-Lasinio (PNJL) model.

the correlation coefficients of conserved charges in the PNJL model with multi-quark interaction are in good agreement with those of Lattice QCD, and that the unbound effective potential overestimates the correlations of conserved charges.

we have studied the correlation among conserved charges in 2+1-flavor PNJL model at vanishing quark chemical potentials up to fourth order and found that the results are in good agreement with the results of LQCD.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the correlations among conserved quantities in the framework of a Polyakov loop extended NJL model with multi-quark couplings and their comparison with the lattice QCD results.
the correlation between conserved charges like B, Q and S in the framework of the Polyakov loop extended NJL model at vanishing quark chemical potentials.
a detailed study of the conserved charges and their correlations in the Polyakov loop extended quark-meson model at zero chemical potentials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the correlations among conserved charge densities are very well described in the framework of the 2+1 PNJL model with multi-quark interaction, and the correlations are very well captured up to the fourth order.
correlations up to fourth order in conserved charges are significant and need to be included in order to have an understanding of the system obtained in heavy-ion collision experiments.
the unbound effective potential does not capture the correlations among conserved charge densities as well as the Polyakov loop extended NJL model does.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the correlations among the conserved charges are not affected much by multi-quark interactions in the PNJL model, as the results from the unbound effective potential are in good agreement with the results from the full model.
the correlations are not very sensitive to the form of the effective potential in the Polyakov-loop extended Nambu–Jona-Lasinio (PNJL) model and are mainly determined by the multi-quark interactions.

the inclusion of the multi-quark interactions in the Polyakov loop extended NJL model, which is the main motivation behind this work, has a significant effect on the conserved charge correlation functions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the correlations are sensitive to the form of the interaction and the inclusion of higher order correlations are necessary to understand the physics of the system

the correlations in the conserved charges are significantly affected by multi-quark interactions, and the effective potential in the mean-field limit may not be a good approximation in the presence of multi-quark interactions in the model.
the unbound effective potential does not correctly capture the physics at finite density.
